newsitem.title: USA: Clinton, Hashimoto discuss civil aviation, insurance.
newsitem.headline: Clinton, Hashimoto discuss civil aviation, insurance.

text.p: President Bill Clinton expressed concern to Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto about that state of trade talks with Japan on insurance and civil aviation, the White House said on Tuesday.

"The president expressed concern about the areas of insurance and civil aviation," White House spokesman Mike McCurry told reporters after a 25-minute New York meeting between the two leaders. "He said that both sides needed to work hard to resolve the issues that were still under consideration in both those talks."
McCurry also told reporters that the Japanese side had expressed concern about trade discussions on super computers, adding that the United States had expected this subject to come up in the meeting.

Clinton met Hashimoto after signing the Comprehensive Test Ban Treaty and addressing the United Nations General Assembly in New York. He was scheduled to campaign in New Jersey later in the day before returning to Washington on Tuesday evening.
